name: Merino Crewneck Sweater
description: Midweight sweater knit from 100% extra-fine merino wool. Naturally temperature regulating and odor resistant, with ribbed cuffs and hem. Machine washable on the wool cycle.

name: Classic Fit Oxford Shirt
description: Button-down oxford in brushed 100% cotton with a relaxed classic fit. Chest pocket, mother-of-pearl style buttons, and a collar that holds its shape without a tie.

name: Stretch Chino Pants
description: Everyday chinos in a cotton-elastane twill with 2% stretch. Straight leg, mid rise, and a wrinkle-resistant finish. Available in waist sizes 28 to 40.

name: Organic Cotton T-Shirt 3-Pack
description: Three crew-neck tees in GOTS-certified organic cotton. Pre-shrunk, tagless, and soft after the first wash. Comes in white, heather grey and navy.

name: Waterproof Rain Jacket
description: Fully seam-sealed 2.5-layer shell with a 10,000mm waterproof rating and a packable hood. Underarm vents and two zippered hand pockets. Packs into its own chest pocket.

name: Fleece-Lined Joggers
description: Cotton-blend joggers with a brushed fleece interior for cold evenings. Elastic waist with drawcord, tapered ankle cuffs, and deep side pockets.

name: Slim Dark Denim Jeans
description: Slim-fit jeans in 12oz selvedge-style denim with a touch of stretch. Dark indigo wash, five-pocket styling, and a mid rise. Machine wash cold, inside out.

name: Wool Blend Overcoat
description: Knee-length overcoat in a 70% wool, 30% recycled polyester blend. Fully lined, notch lapel, two inner pockets. Dry clean only.

name: Performance Running Shorts
description: Lightweight 5-inch running shorts with a built-in liner, reflective trim, and a zippered back pocket. Quick-dry recycled polyester fabric.

name: Linen Summer Dress
description: Midi dress in washed European linen with a square neckline, adjustable shoulder ties, and side pockets. Breathable and relaxed through the body.

name: NovaBeat Wireless Earbuds
description: True wireless earbuds with Bluetooth 5.4, 8 hours of playback and 24 more from the charging case. IPX5 sweat resistance and three sizes of silicone tips.

name: Aurora 27-inch 4K Monitor
description: 27-inch IPS display with 3840x2160 resolution, 99% sRGB coverage, and a 60Hz refresh rate. USB-C input with 65W power delivery, height-adjustable stand.

name: PulseFit Fitness Tracker
description: Slim tracker with continuous heart rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking. 10-day battery life, 5ATM water resistance, and built-in GPS for runs and rides.

description: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable linear switches, PBT keycaps, and per-key white backlighting. Wired USB-C, 1.8m braided cable.

description: Vertical ergonomic mouse that keeps the wrist in a handshake position. Bluetooth or 2.4GHz receiver, adjustable 800 to 3200 DPI, and up to 6 months on one AA battery.

name: SoundCore Bluetooth Speaker
description: Portable speaker with 360-degree sound, 12 hours of playtime, and IP67 dust and water resistance. Pair two speakers for stereo. USB-C charging.

name: 65W GaN USB-C Charger
description: Compact gallium nitride wall charger with two USB-C ports and one USB-A. Charges a laptop and phone at once. Foldable plug, 1.5m cable included.

name: 1080p Home Security Camera
description: Indoor Wi-Fi camera with 1080p video, night vision to 8 metres, two-way audio, and person detection. Works with microSD storage up to 256GB.

name: Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
description: Over-ear Bluetooth headphones with hybrid active noise cancellation, 40-hour battery, multipoint pairing, and a foldable design with a hard carry case.

name: Memory Foam Pillow

name: Ceramic Table Lamp

name: Woven Cotton Throw Blanket
description: Textured 50 by 60 inch throw in a chunky cotton weave with tasselled edges. Machine washable, available in oatmeal, sage and charcoal.

name: Cordless Robot Vacuum
description: Robot vacuum with 3000Pa suction, gyroscope navigation, and a 150-minute runtime. Self-docks to recharge, handles hard floors and low-pile carpet, app and voice control.

name: Bamboo Bath Towel Set

name: Floating Wall Shelf Set

name: Blackout Curtain Panels
description: Pair of thermal blackout curtains, 52 by 84 inches each, with grommet tops. Blocks 99% of light and reduces outside noise. Machine washable.

name: Ultrasonic Humidifier
